jyutping: zoeng1 A zeoi6 maai4 jat1 cai4

english.note: Use this causative pattern when bringing people or things together in one place.

examples.english: I congregate the documents in one folder so everyone can read them easily.
examples.traditional: 將啲文件聚埋一齊，方便大家睇。
